description:
Kevin Ng & Co. is hiring a Trainee Solicitor (2027 Intake) in Hong Kong. Monthly Salary: HK$21,000 – HK$23,000 (negotiable)

You will:
• Assist principals and solicitors in providing all-round general practice legal services, handling civil, criminal, matrimonial litigation, and non-contentious matters
• Draft legal correspondence, pleadings, agreements, and commercial documents
• Conduct comprehensive legal research and prepare case summaries and memoranda
• Attend court hearings, client meetings, legal visits, and conferences with counsel
• Conduct due diligence, document review, and transaction completions, as well as prepare trial opening/closing submissions and compile hearing bundles
• Maintain case files, provide client updates, manage deadlines, and liaise with court registries, clients, and external parties

You have:
• Law Degree or equivalent (LL.B., J.D., GDL, etc.) and completed PCLL
• Fluent Cantonese, Putonghua, and English (written and spoken), with proficiency in Chinese and English word processing
• Strong IT skills, including proficiency in Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, and practical experience applying AI tools to legal research and practice
• Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills with keen attention to detail
• Proactive learning attitude with strong interpersonal skills
• Good team player capable of working under pressure and meeting tight deadlines

To apply, please send your CV to career@kevinngsolicitors.com
